name: Super Productivity
author: Patrick Fanella
description: Track and control Super Productivity tasks from the Omarchy bar, with all widget settings available inside the popup.

barWidget.description: Live countdown, task controls, Quick Add, Today hierarchy, alerts, and in-plugin settings in one popup.

schema.label: Status refresh
schema.description: Seconds between helper checks. The countdown continues locally between checks.

schema.label: Maximum bar width
schema.description: Maximum width in pixels before the task title is shortened.

schema.label: Show while idle
schema.description: Keep a quiet Super Productivity marker in the bar when no task is active.

schema.label: Task alerts
schema.description: Notify when a countdown expires or a scheduled task reaches its start time, including while tracking.

schema.label: Play alert sound
schema.description: Play the configured sound for countdown-expiry and scheduled-start alerts.

schema.label: Alert volume
schema.description: Volume for countdown and scheduled-start alert sounds and previews.

schema.label: Alert sound path
schema.description: Custom sound used by countdown-expiry and scheduled-start alerts. Leave blank for the bundled sound.

schema.label: Notification urgency
schema.description: Notification urgency used for countdown-expiry and scheduled-start alerts.

schema.label: Start next after Complete
schema.description: After a panel-issued Complete, start the next runnable child or Today task when no other task became current.

schema.label: Add & switch
schema.description: When checked, Enter and the inline plus create the task and switch to it.
